usage: Used for planting seeds in a garden, farm, or pot. It sounds natural in everyday Cantonese when talking about growing plants.
Commonly used with verbs like 開始、準備、進行 to describe the action of starting seed planting. It can also be used more broadly in gardening contexts.
This word is neutral and practical, so it fits both casual speech and simple instructional writing about gardening.
Learners should treat it as a set gardening action term. In conversation, people may also say 撒種 or 落種 depending on the context.
